title: Wire loop-runner events to RocketLoopApp state
description: In RocketLoopApp, consume the AsyncGenerator from loop-runner.ts via useEffect or a custom hook. Map each LoopEvent type to the corresponding state transition.
acceptanceCriteria: iteration-start events update the current iteration counter
output events append lines to the output preview
blocked event transitions to 'blocked' state with the reason
decide event transitions to 'decide' state with the question
timing events update per-iteration timing data

steps.description: Create a custom hook for consuming the loop generator
steps.details: Create src/tui/hooks/useLoopRunner.ts. The hook takes LoopOptions and returns { events, state }. Inside, uses useEffect to iterate the generator and dispatch state updates.
In useEffect: `(async () => { for await (const event of runLoop(options)) { dispatch(event) } })(). Return cleanup function that breaks the generator: set an abort flag checked in the loop.

steps.description: Map events to state transitions in reducer
steps.details: Create a reducer function that handles each event type and returns the new state: iteration-start → { currentIteration: n }, output → { outputLines: [...prev, line] }, complete → { appState: 'complete' }, etc.
In RocketLoopApp, call useLoopRunner(options) when a task is selected. Use the returned state to drive the rendering.

technicalNotes: Cannot use async/await directly in useEffect — wrap in an IIFE: (async () => { ... })()
The generator cleanup on component unmount is important to prevent memory leaks and orphan AI processes
